scenes.name: hook
scenes.text: You talk about shoes with a friend, and later you see a shoe ad. Is your phone listening? Probably not. Here's what's really going on.

scenes.name: listen
scenes.text: Researchers who studied popular apps haven't found evidence that they secretly record your conversations for ads. There are simpler explanations.

scenes.name: tracking
scenes.text: Many websites include invisible trackers. When you browse shoes, ad companies note it, and follow you to other sites and apps.

scenes.name: location
scenes.text: If apps have location access, they may know you visited a shoe store, or a mall, and use that for ads.

scenes.name: friends
scenes.text: If your friend searched for shoes, and you're often near each other or connected, you may be grouped together and see similar ads.

scenes.name: auction
scenes.text: Each time a page loads, advertisers bid for your attention in a split second auction, using this profile of you.

scenes.name: control
scenes.text: You can limit ad tracking in your phone settings, turn off ad personalisation, and deny location to apps that don't need it.

scenes.name: outro
scenes.text: Trackers, location, friends, auction. Not magic, just data. Follow for more on how things really work.
